purpose: Development-only support audit for whether a fixed +32 probe has enough positive incremental examples among the now-confirmed direct_gap65_47 rejects to justify fitting any probe gate. This is not a confirmation split and cannot modify the confirmed direct threshold 47.
seed_novelty_check: Repository search before creation found no own-role occurrence of exact seeds 922000 or 923000.
search_contract: Exactly the frozen ROBDD/local-relocation substrate and endpoint oracle used by the two preceding confirmations. Retain the verified natural+RCM incumbent. Audit full seeded challenger tails for evaluation; every candidate BDD compilation is charged.
population: Start from frozen-v1 stop states. The confirmed direct incumbent buys the full tail when gap65 <= 47. The probe-support population is the direct-reject subset gap65 > 47, where direct deployed incremental compute is zero.
fixed_probe_action: For each direct reject, execute the existing challenger through min(index97, exhaustion). If not exhausted and gap97 <= 47, buy the remaining full tail. If exhausted, merge any verified improvement. Retained-incumbent merge prevents quality harm.

labels.probe_rescue_positive: direct rejects (gap65 > 47) for which the fixed probe causes a tail purchase (gap97 <= 47) and the audited tail has positive gain over the retained incumbent
labels.probe_incremental_gain: verified gain recovered by the fixed probe minus direct recovered gain (zero for every direct reject)
labels.probe_incremental_compute: candidate compilations spent by the fixed probe policy on the direct reject
labels.late_positive_not_rescued: direct reject with audited positive tail but gap97 remains >47, so the fixed probe spends compute but still stops

support_gate_before_any_model_fit.if_failed: FAILED_SUPPORT_FOR_PROBE_GATE; do not fit or threshold a probe classifier on this split. Preserve direct_gap65_47 and move the frontier toward heterogeneous probe actions or a different state representation.

primary_metrics: audited positive direct-reject count and gain
fixed-probe incremental compile fraction relative to exhaustive direct-reject tails
no_adaptation: Do not alter index97, threshold47, seed ranges, support gate, graph families, search contract or label definitions after any 922xxx/923xxx outcome is opened. Do not fit a model unless the preregistered support gate passes. Do not use 918xxx/919xxx or 920xxx/921xxx confirmation outcomes as training rows.
scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD ordering development only; not theorem-proving evidence.
